dedupe_keys.name: assessing robustness in multimodal transportation systems a case study in lisbon

description: The executed multiplex-network model assesses eight transport modes under random, degree, betweenness and multimodal-hub targeting of stations and links. It compares fixed and recalculated centralities and simulates cascade-like disruption of whole lines. Normalized area-under-curve measures permit comparisons between mode layers of different sizes. Results concern topological connectedness, path lengths and component structure; they do not capture every passenger, capacity or recovery process. The companion deposited NetworkX graph dictionary is already catalogued and contains nine operator graphs, a different counting basis from the paper’s eight modes. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
